key_results: SAGAN-ResNet18 achieved better performance than GAN baselines; synthetic samples reduced negative impact of limited training data on BCI Competition IV-2a dataset
comments: Addresses practical BCI data scarcity via synthetic augmentation, though within-subject generalization remains unclear.

model_io.model: SA-GAN + ResNet-18

hypotheses.hypothesis: Synthetic MI samples generated by SA-GAN provide valuable training information for limited-data EEG classification
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: SAGAN-ResNet18 outperformed non-augmented baselines on within-subject BCI Competition IV-2a task

title: WSPI: a wavelet-structured popularity index for stable content ranking via trend–noise separation
task: Wavelet-based popularity scoring for stable content ranking under transient spikes
key_results: WSPI achieves 2.0–2.8× lower rank displacement under injected spikes versus best baseline; consistently highest ranking stability (RSI@10) across 6 datasets; accuracy–stability trade-off with later reaction time
comments: Training-free wavelet method effective for spike suppression; late reaction to genuine surges may reduce timeliness in dynamic caching.

model_io.model: DWT+AF, DTCWT+AF, WSPI (wavelet-based)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Wavelet-extracted trend provides superior stability and spike robustness compared to window-based count aggregation
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: WSPI achieves 2.0–2.8× lower rank displacement under synthetic spikes; consistently highest RSI@10 across YouTube, taxi, MovieLens datasets

title: Exact nonlinear wave structures in the conformable time-fractional Vakhnenko equation via bilinear neural networks
task: Exact nonlinear wave structures in conformable time-fractional Vakhnenko equation via bilinear neural networks
key_results: Closed-form integrable solution families derived: one-soliton, two-soliton with phase shift, breather, cnoidal wave; fractional order acts as tunable time-scale parameter with power-law wave propagation; orbital stability confirmed numerically
comments: Algebraic closed-form solutions avoid discretization errors; framework flexible and extensible to related fractional nonlinear wave models.

model_io.model: Bilinear neural network ansatz + conformable Hirota bilinear operator

hypotheses.hypothesis: Conformable bilinear neural network framework yields exact closed-form solutions preserving amplitude/width while power-law wave propagation speed decelerates with fractional order ε < 1
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: one/two-soliton, breather, cnoidal solutions derived; orbital stability verified; fractional order equivalent to time-varying relaxation rate

title: A novel cost-effective layout-aware quantum circuit synthesis of symmetric functions on triangular, square, and heavy-hex layouts
task: Layout-aware quantum circuit synthesis for symmetric functions on physical quantum architectures
key_results: Reed–Muller Lattice approach achieves cost-efficient mappings on square-grid and heavy-hex layouts without additional SWAP gates via SWAT gate; 98.3% teacher F1 retained in distilled student (3.1 MB)
comments: SWAT gate design novel and hardware-specific; triangular layout theoretical; near-term quantum feasibility hinges on SWAT gate implementation.

model_io.model: Reed–Muller Lattice + SWAT gate + layout-aware mapping

hypotheses.hypothesis: Reed–Muller Lattice representation with SWAT gate reduces layout mapping overhead for symmetric functions versus ESOP/BDD synthesis
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: cost-efficient mappings achieved on square-grid and heavy-hex without extra SWAP gates; distillation preserves 98.3% teacher F1

title: Strict liability for maritime autonomous surface ships: rethinking tortious accountability in the age of autonomy
task: Strict liability framework for maritime autonomous surface ships tort accountability
key_results: Shipowner-centered strict liability with two-tier structure, liability caps, and compulsory insurance optimal for MASS torts; balances victim redress, risk allocation, and industry viability
comments: Theoretical institutional design; practical implementation challenges (e.g., algorithmic opacity, remote operation liability) remain unresolved.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Strict liability centered on shipowner is optimal institutional choice for MASS tort accountability versus fault-based or product-liability models
hypotheses.result: Reasoned conclusion: strict liability aligns with risk-control, risk-dispersion, and cost-avoidance principles; two-tier structure extends to charterers, operators, managers under specific circumstances

title: Towards ecologically meaningful foundation models
task: Developing ecological foundation models for multi-modal species and ecosystem data
key_results: Roadmap outlined for ecoFM development; identifies data, model architecture, evaluation strategy, and governance requirements; highlights gaps in current ML and ecological approaches for multi-modal integration and theory-guided learning
comments: Visionary framework; practical implementation challenges (data standardization, ecological theory integration, uncertainty quantification) substantial.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Ecological foundation models trained on multi-modal data and informed by ecological theory enable unified pattern-process understanding and cross-subdiscipline synthesis
hypotheses.result: Theoretical claim: ecoFMs could improve generalization, link pattern to process, enable ecological synthesis; practical roadmap requires data infrastructure, architectures, evaluation strategies, governance development

title: Freespace “twistronics”: moiré structured light for optical supertopologies
task: Generate topological moiré structures in free-space structured light
key_results: Tunable twist angle generates skyrmionium bags, skyrmion superlattices, clusters, and quasicrystals; topologies maintain nondiffractive propagation over long distances with robustness to perturbations
comments: Compelling concept extending moiré physics to higher dimensions, but experimental demonstration and practical information encoding capacity require further development.

model_io.model: Moiré structured light field in free space

hypotheses.hypothesis: Moiré superlattices in structured light can generate nontrivial topologies absent in other systems
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; skyrmionium bags and quasicrystals observed

hypotheses.hypothesis: Moiré topologies persist over long-distance propagation with topological robustness
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; nondiffractive behavior and obstacle robustness demonstrated

title: Resolving phonons in superconductor Bi2Sr2CaCu2O8+δ at sub-unit-cell resolution
task: Resolve phonon modes in cuprate superconductor with sub-unit-cell precision
key_results: Identified three layer-specific phonon modes: ~78 meV in CuO₂ planes, ~42 meV hybrid modes in CuO₂, ~38 meV hybrid modes in BiO layers; phonon frequency modulation correlates with superconducting gap variation
comments: Advances understanding of electron-phonon coupling in cuprates, though causality between structure and superconductivity remains unestablished.

model_io.model: Bi₂Sr₂CaCu₂O₈₊δ crystal

hypotheses.hypothesis: Phonon modes localize to specific layers with distinct energies
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; layer-specific localization observed

hypotheses.hypothesis: Superstructure modulates phonon frequencies and correlates with gap variation
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; periodic frequency modulation observed

title: Harvesting magic resource in curved spacetime
task: Harvest magic (non-stabilizerness) from quantum vacuum in curved spacetime
key_results: Stronger spacetime curvature and higher dimensionality suppress extractable magic; analytic series method resolves previously intractable divergences in coherence
comments: Novel mathematical technique addresses a gap in relativistic quantum information theory, though practical applications to quantum technologies remain speculative.

model_io.model: Unruh-DeWitt detector in AdS spacetime

hypotheses.hypothesis: Spacetime curvature suppresses harvestable magic from vacuum
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; effect strengthens with dimensionality

title: Continuous directed evolution using engineered human B cell lines
task: Evolve antibodies and proteins using engineered somatic hypermutation in human B cells
key_results: Successfully evolved neutralizing antibodies against avian influenza and escape variants using continuous directed evolution in human B cell lines with broad mutational spectrum (substitutions, deletions, insertions)
comments: Clever repurposing of natural immune mechanisms for synthetic evolution, though translation to non-antibody proteins and therapeutic efficacy remain to be demonstrated.

model_io.model: CODE-HB (human B cell directed evolution platform)
inputs: Selection pressure (viral antigen or escape variant)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Engineered somatic hypermutation at non-immunoglobulin loci can evolve biotechnologically relevant proteins
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: platform evolved neutralizing antibodies against avian influenza and escape variants

hypotheses.hypothesis: SHM mechanisms can generate broad mutational spectrum (substitutions, deletions, insertions) beyond simple point mutations
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: platform produces substitutions, deletions, and insertions
